desc: Ideation: reduce to `answer = min_T (runs(T) + inv(A→T))`, refute the "perfect-swap greedy" conjecture, propose the run-based 2-state DP.
Write the validation script (BFS ground truth + permutation cost model + run DP, exhaustive over equality patterns N ≤ 7 plus random N = 8..10 stress).
Write the final O(ΣN) submission (run compression + iterative 2-state DP, bulk IO, single write) — hand-checked on samples 1–3 and on `1 2 1 3 2 3` (= 5).

Prove the structural lemma: never split a run (exchange argument on per-class inversion cost `f(c)`), and every indecomposable block of size ≥3 is dominated by identity or by an adjacent run transposition (`inv_w ≥ k−1`, internal merges ≤ k−2, ≤2 boundary merges) ⇒ optimum is a product of disjoint adjacent run transpositions.
Generalized bounded-window DP — not needed, lemma holds.

Edge-case & performance pass: R=1/all-equal → 1; all-distinct → N; `1 1 2 1 1` → 3 and `2 1 1 2` → 3 (weighted swap cost 2 > merge gain 1); 11-alternating → 8; index guards `i>=1`,`i>=2` and array sizes (`dpB` length R+2) verified; O(ΣN)=2·10⁵ with one bulk read/write handles T=10⁵.
